agent: A single illustration shows a central humanoid robot with a glowing brain labeled "LLM", its arms extended into six labeled circular panels representing a web browser, email, calendar, payment system, messaging app, and a generic software tool; from each panel, a curved arrow loops back to the robot's eyes to indicate observation and adjustment after each action. A small speech-only chatbot icon sits in a corner crossed out in red, contrasting with the robot's active limbs. large-language-model: The illustration shows a single unified scene where a vast, cloud-shaped neural network is built from layered pages of books, websites, and code, with streams of text flowing into it from all directions while a person types a prompt into a terminal connected to the network. From the network's center, a ribbon of words emerges one at a time and splits into multiple branches labeled writing, coding, translation, and agent commands, each branch forming a coherent output. Hovering beside the network are a broken hourglass and an empty file cabinet containing only the current prompt, suggesting the absence of lasting memory. A large speech bubble from the network displays a confidently worded but factually incorrect statement with a small disclaimer reading may be wrong, illustrating confident errors. Finally, a finite frame labeled context window encloses only the most recent words on the ribbon, while older words fade and fall into a bin marked forgotten, capturing the limits of attention and recall.
